title: Node tool-results aggregate (tool-results.json)
description: ADR-0010 task V03. The deterministic per-node aggregate of tool instances. Cross-record rules (node status vs instances, declared tools, coverage and probe agreement) are enforced by appsec-review-process/tool_instance_shapes.py.

job_id.description: Owning graph node. A pattern, not a const: the shape is shared by every ADR-0010 family node and by D09's 02-source-sast.

attempt_id.description: The NODE attempt that published this aggregate. Tool instances carry their own attempt ids.

source_snapshot_sha256.description: Intake source-snapshot identity every tool instance and the probe ran against.
